sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Explore the nervous system in animals, including neurons and nerve impulses.
Differentiate between reflex actions and voluntary actions.
Discover the structure and functions of the human brain.
Learn about coordination mechanisms in plants, including plant hormones.
Understand the role of hormones and the endocrine system in animals.

sections.title: Introduction to Animal Nervous Systems
learning_goals: Define control and coordination in biological systems.
Identify the key components of the animal nervous system.
Explain the function of neurons, including sensory and motor neurons.
Differentiate between voluntary and involuntary actions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: This section covers definitions and conceptual understanding of the nervous system, best presented with text and diagrams.

sections.title: Reflex Actions and the Reflex Arc
learning_goals: Define reflex action and provide examples.
Describe the components and pathway of a reflex arc.

sections.title: The Human Brain: Structure and Functions
learning_goals: Identify the main divisions of the human nervous system (CNS and PNS).
Describe the structure and functions of the forebrain, midbrain, and hindbrain.
Locate and explain the roles of the cerebrum, cerebellum, medulla, and pons.
Understand how the brain is protected.

sections.title: Coordination in Plants: Tropisms and Hormones
learning_goals: Explain different types of tropic movements in plants.

learning_goals: Define hormones and their role in animal coordination.
